name: lorenz63_generator_lyapunov_vs_sprott_2003
detail: largest Lyapunov exponent of the synthetic truth (Benettin) against the published 0.906 (J. C. Sprott, Chaos and Time-Series Analysis, 2003); tolerance 5 %. It checks the data generator, not the forecasts, which have no independent reference

name: beats_best_baseline_on_untouched_test
detail: every chaotic series: at least one model beats the best baseline (chosen on validation) on the untouched test block, one-sided Diebold-Mariano, Holm-corrected p < 0.05

name: no_false_skill_on_pure_noise
detail: negative controls: no model may beat the baseline on white noise or a random walk

name: iaaft_test_flags_nonlinearity_only_where_present
detail: IAAFT surrogate test of permutation entropy rejects on chaotic truths only (synthetic cases)
